description: Annual accounts of a Norwegian company from the official Regnskapsregisteret (Brønnøysundregistrene, NLOD 2.0): the latest filed fiscal year fetched live, plus every earlier year accumulated since 2026-07 (the register only serves the latest one). Balance sheet (assets, equity, debts), P&L (operating income and result, net result), figures as published in the filing currency (can be USD, never converted). Banks and insurers are not served by the source. Legal persons only: a sole proprietorship (ENK), a registered individual (PERS, TVAM), an estate (KBO, BO), a foreign branch or entity (NUF, UTLA) whose name does not end with a written legal-person form valid in its home country (followed at most by branch words), or recorded there as a sole proprietorship, or a form not recognised as a legal person returns 404, not billed, judged before any storage. No default-risk score is computed for this country yet: the response carries score_defaillance (statut non_evaluable, closed-list reasons explained by GET /v1/lecture); never read it as a low score. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_norwegian_company_accounts
